question: The travel bookings were at the highest monthly level in the U.S. in the month of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is **"February."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us look at the first sentence of the last paragraph:
 
 
• *"Market research firm AirDNA, which tracks business on Airbnb Inc. and rival home-rental site Vrbo, said bookings made in the U.S. in February reached their highest monthly level since it began tracking the industry in 2015."*
 
 
 
• The highest monthly level of travel bookings in the U.S. was in February.
 
• The correct answer is option 1.

 

**Correct sentence**: *The travel bookings were at the highest monthly level in the U.S. in the month of February.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2, June, is not correct as it is not the month with the highest level of travel bookings in the U.S.
 
• Option 3, April, is not correct as it is not the month with the highest level of travel bookings in the U.S.
 
• Option 4, May, is not correct as it is not the month with the highest level of travel bookings in the U.S.
